transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, what finally pushed me to come in is that I'm having a lot of trouble focusing at work. I can start an EPIC quality report, or sit down in a clinic metrics meeting with every intention of tracking what's going on, but... within just a few minutes, my mind has drifted so far off. I end up just rereading the same numbers over and over, or I'll suddenly realize I completely missed the whole point of the discussion. It's just becoming a real problem for me.
Did you have similar difficulties with focus and attention when you were growing up, such as in elementary or middle school?

Yes, I did. Even back in elementary school, I remember my teachers writing on my report cards that I was bright, but careless. And my mother actually had to sit right there with me while I finished my homework. If she didn't, I would just lose track of what the assignments even were, or I'd realize I completely forgot to bring my books home from school in the first place. So, yes, it's been an issue for a long time.
Alongside those focus issues, do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble sitting still?

No, not really. I... I don't have much of a problem sitting still. I can sit at my desk or stay in a long meeting just fine without feeling the need to get up or move around. It's really just my mind that wanders off, not my body.
Do these difficulties with focus and organization cause problems in your daily life outside of work, such as at home or managing personal responsibilities?

Yes, it definitely spills over. Even at work, it's gotten to the point where my delays are affecting the clinic reporting deadlines, which makes other teams have to wait on me. And outside of work... well, I help out with these volunteer health workshops, and I've actually had to step back from leading parts of them recently. I just can't reliably keep all the planning pieces moving. It's frustrating to have to give that up, but I just couldn't stay on top of the organization it required.
